descriptor: Team workspace with a calm notification centre

voice.summary: Orbit sounds like a thoughtful teammate who tells you only what matters, in order. Updates name the person, the document and the change in one tidy line.
dos: Name who did what, in that order
donts: Do not use alarm language for ordinary updates
Never badge a number that is not unread

taglines: Everything that needs you, nothing that doesn't
boilerplate: Orbit is a team workspace whose notification centre groups mentions, system alerts and updates by day, so people can catch up without being interrupted.
